# CC15: 映清斋 Yingqing Zhai

Wave 3 · Changchun Yuan · 3D: `/reconstruction/3d.html?b=CC15` · Page: `/scenes/#CC15` · Row: `research/buildings/CC15-yingqing-zhai/`

## What it was

映清斋 Yingqing Zhai, "Studio of Reflected Clarity", south-east of the pavilion 昭旷亭, which stands south of 玉玲珑馆 (S05 j83:18a; E0307). Added in 1766 as a new residence of 玉玲珑馆 (E0165). S361 describes a water garden: a fan-shaped nine-bay study with water on three sides and curved galleries, the open hall 月香水影, the five-bay two-storey 晴望楼, 益思堂, 陶嘉书屋, 豁如室 and the double-eaved square 昭旷亭 (E0308). Poems 1766-1776 (E0302-E0306). Not among the buildings left standing after 1860 (E0451, after 刘敦桢), so it burned in October 1860 (S02 pp.187-188).

From the inventory row: **built** 1766; **destroyed** 1860 (S05, S48, S01, S201, S361).
